notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 HLAlogicalTime and HLAlogicalTimeInterval DataElement wrappers. The source uses only the standard C++ API and library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. It verifies wrapper construction through the RTIambassador, selected-factory round trips, nested-buffer encoding, clone and copy independence, type compatibility failures, and truncated-value failures without asserting provider-specific behavior.
